{"path":"solution.py","content":"def transform(request):
    text = request.get("text", "")
    
    # Handle null/empty input
    if not text or not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
        return None
    
    # Extract digits only from the string
    digits_only = ''.join(c for c in text if c.isdigit())
    
    # Remove leading '1' (country code indicator when written without +)
    normalized_digits = digits_only.lstrip('1')
    
    # Check if we have exactly 10 remaining digits after removing optional leading 1
    if len(normalized_digits) == 10:
        return f"+1{normalized_digits}"
    else:
        return None
